title: Coding Assistant
prompt: Help me understand, debug, and improve this code. Explain the problem clearly and suggest a clean solution.

title: Code Reviewer
prompt: Review this code for bugs, security issues, readability, and performance. Give specific suggestions for improvement.

title: Summarizer
prompt: Summarize the following text into clear and concise bullet points while keeping the most important information.

title: Study Assistant
prompt: Explain this topic step by step in simple language and give me a few examples to help me understand it.

title: Brainstorming
prompt: Generate several creative ideas for this problem. For each idea, briefly explain its advantages and possible drawbacks.
